subject: MAP: Success definition and cutover tempo for WellnessAI evaluation
messages:
From: Amanda Park <amanda.park@wellnessai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP proposal: success criteria & cutover tempo (WellnessAI eval)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — very helpful. As we discussed, the execs want a short, airtight mutual action plan that nails down: what success looks like, the concrete acceptance tests we’ll run, and the cutover timeline if the pilot hits the gates.

High level asks from our side:
- A 4-week evaluation window with a scheduled validation week at the end.
- Clear pass/fail metrics for latency, throughput, regression on our gold dataset, and data handling (retention & deletion).
- A small rollback/fallback plan if production thresholds aren’t met.

I attached a short doc that reflects WellnessAI’s priorities and a suggested procurement path. Can your team propose a draft MAP that maps owners, artifacts, and dates? We want to share a one-page MAP with our leadership by next Monday (9/6).

Also looping procurement (procurement@wellnessai.com) so they can flag any contract timing constraints early.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Amanda Park
Head of Product, WellnessAI
Amanda.Park@wellnessai.com

Attachments: WellnessAI_MAP_request.docx (docx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Park <amanda.park@wellnessai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP proposal: success criteria & cutover tempo (WellnessAI eval)

Amanda — really appreciate the clear list. We pulled together a compact MAP draft that maps success signals to specific tests, owners, and a target cutover sequence. High level summary below (I attached a PDF with the full table):

Proposed cadence and ownership:
- Week 0 (kickoff): config, dataset handoff (WellnessAI), enablement call, baseline smoke test — owner: Marissa (sales/ops)
- Weeks 1–3 (evaluation): workload tests + functional checks — owner: Ben (infra/ops)
- Week 4 (validation): production-like validation window + final acceptance checkpoint — owner: Marissa (signoff)

Core acceptance tests (pass/fail):
- Performance: p95 inference latency < 600ms for 2k token average prompt under pilot traffic (measured on Redwood Dedicated dev pool)
- Throughput: sustained 400 reqs/min for 1-hour soak without KV cache misses exceeding 5%
- Quality/regression: key-label F1 >= 0.86 on WellnessAI gold set; top-3 precision for classification tasks >= 92%
- Safety/data: no PII leakage incidents in 10k-sample audit; customer-requested retention deletion exercise completed within 48 hours

Rollback & fallback:
- Auto-fallback to smaller model variant + 15% throttling policy if latency SLO violated for >15 minutes
- Contingency: rollback to pre-integration snapshot if validation week fails on >2 critical tests

Docs and next steps:
- Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (maps owners, dates, and required artifacts)
- If this looks reasonable we’ll: 1) run the baseline smoke test during kickoff, 2) share the acceptance-tests spreadsheet to Ben, 3) link SOC2 / KMS evidence for procurement.

Can you confirm procurement timeline and whether WellnessAI needs a PO before the validation window? We can adapt the schedule but want to keep the leadership update on 9/6.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Amanda Park <amanda.park@wellnessai.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 18:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP proposal: success criteria & cutover tempo (WellnessAI eval)

Adding technical acceptance test detail and owners — Amanda, this is the set we’ll actually run during Weeks 1–4. I synced with infra and SRE to ensure the tests are runnable in our dedicated dev pool and reproducible for your auditors.

Acceptance test matrix (excerpts):
- Latency profile measurement: 95th percentile over 30-minute rolling windows, measured via tracing hooks. Test owner: Ben. Threshold: p95 < 600ms. Measurement artifact: trace export + summarized CSV.
- Throughput soak: 60-minute load at target QPS; monitor KV hit-rate and GPU utilization. Test owner: Ben. Failure if KV misses >5% OR OOMs observed. Artifact: load runner logs.
- Regression suite: run your gold dataset (10k labeled examples) through current baseline + Redwood model; compute F1 / precision / recall. Test owner: Marissa & WellnessAI data contact. Failure if F1 delta <= -0.03 vs baseline. Artifact: labeled-results.csv and diff report.
- Privacy / retention drill: issue an API-driven deletion for 500 sample records, confirm deletion via audit log within 48 hours. Test owner: Marissa. Artifact: audit.log excerpt.
- Security evidence: link to SOC2 and KMS audit we’ll provide (read-only link for procurement).

Operational runbook notes:
- Environment tag: well-ai-eval-2026-09 (used for all monitoring dashboards)
- Test-window scheduling: please confirm blackout windows for WellnessAI (maintenance, backups) so we avoid false negatives.

I attached a spreadsheet (MAP_Acceptance_Tests.xlsx) that lists step-by-step commands, expected artifacts, and a pass/fail column the validation team can sign off on. Suggest we run an initial smoke ASAP (tomorrow morning) to confirm the telemetry hooks are working.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

1) Procurement: procurement needs to confirm whether a PO is required before Week 4 validation. They prefer a preliminary SOW + estimated invoice (we can use the pilot discount you offered on the call). Procurement contact is Jenn Ortiz (jenn.ortiz@wellnessai.com).

2) Validation window: WellnessAI confirms no blackout windows the week of 9/27 — that works for a full validation.

3) Acceptance tweaks: we can accept the latency and throughput thresholds; one request — add an availability SLO to the validation: 99.5% request success rate (no 5xx) during the 1-hour soak.

4) Discount & sign-off: I’ve attached an updated MAP with WellnessAI edits and a procurement placeholder for billing cadence. Can Redwood produce a DocuSign SOW with the pilot terms (dates + provisional discount)? If possible, we’d like to circulate the one-page MAP to leadership Monday morning (9/6).

If you’re okay I’ll sign the MAP on our side once we get the DocuSign SOW and the SOC2 read-only link.
